identity: ONE original armoured warden, the Mirrorback Warden veteran, facing screen right in elevated three-quarter view. Keep the ivory and gold plate armour, the closed crystalline crested helmet, the long blue tabard with a gold emblem, and the fan of blue-violet gold-framed crystal shards rising behind the back and shoulders. Exactly two arms, two hands and two legs. The near screen-LEFT hand holds ONE crystal short sword; the far screen-RIGHT arm carries ONE faceted oval shield with a sunburst of blue-violet crystal panels and a gold rim. Preserve the sword, the shield, the back shards, the crest and the armoured adult proportions.
plate: Locked orthographic camera, fixed anatomical scale and centred body. Keep the full sword, the shield, the back shards, the crest, limbs and boots within frame. The background is perfectly flat saturated BLUE throughout, no gradients or changes of hue. The blue background stays the same flat saturated blue in every frame and never darkens, flashes or changes colour. No scenery, floor shadow, camera motion, zoom, additional weapons, magic, flashes, motion trails, slash arcs, sparks, particles or extra limbs; the crystals keep only their steady glow. Articulate joints naturally with physical planted-foot support; do not morph the sword or shield.

idle_h3_v1.action: A watchful warden idle that loops. He breathes, the shoulders rise and fall under the plate, he lifts the sword a little and turns the blade, resettles the shield on his arm, the helmeted head turns slightly to scan, then everything returns smoothly to the original stance. Both boots stay planted. No walking and no attack.

move_h3_v1.action: March in place through two complete reciprocal cycles with firm armoured steps. Alternate near and far legs through forward contact, weight loading, passing and lift; both knees articulate and each boot alternates taking weight and swinging. The torso stays centred for engine-driven travel. The sword is held low and the shield carried on the far arm; the tabard swings with the legs. Finish in the original gait phase.

attack_h3_v1.action: Make ONE sword strike toward screen right. He draws the sword back and lifts it high above the shoulder as the knees bend, then drives the torso forward into a lunge and sweeps the blade diagonally down and out to full reach low at screen right, pulls the hilt back to the hip and settles into the original stance. One strike only; the shield stays on the far arm.

hit_h3_v1.action: He starts rocked back in a flinch and recovers from it. The helmeted head and shoulders hunch and twist away, the knees flex and the shield swings in while both hands keep hold of the sword and the shield, then he rebalances on both boots and returns to the same stance. Only the body moves; nothing else appears in the frame.

defend_h3_v1.action: Raise the oval shield in front of the chest and helmet, bend the knees and crouch behind it with the sword held low and ready, then hold the covered guard on both planted boots. No attack and no return to the relaxed stance.

cast_h3_v1.action: A warding salute. He raises the sword upright before his helmet and pushes the shield out at arm's length toward screen right, holds the pose briefly, then lowers both back to the original stance. A physical gesture only: no spell, glow change or aura.

death_h3_v1.action: Collapse slowly and heavily from standing. His knees buckle and he sinks onto one knee, leaning on the shield, and stays there a moment. Then he topples forward onto his side and lies down, finishing motionless with the helmet at screen left and the boots at screen right, the shield lying beside him and the sword on the ground by his hand. The body never leaves the ground; no recovery, no floating equipment and no disappearing body.
